 The film has a massive heart: Ashish Kaul on Netflix’s Diwali premiere, Dilwali Diwali
 Ashish Kaul, who has just wrapped up shooting for Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, is excited to be a part of Netflix's Diwali bonanza with the film, Dilwali Diwali. Read to learn about his experience. 
 Author: Srividya Rajesh 
 Published: 30 Oct,2026 04:12:05 PM 
 Actor Ashish Kaul has consistently proven his versatility, juggling the fast-paced television landscape with the evolving world of web entertainment. Having left his mark with iconic television milestones like Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi and Naagin 7, while continuing to entertain audiences across major projects like AliBaba aur 40 Bhoot, Ashish transitions effortlessly between diverse mediums.
 Now, he is all set to charm viewers in Netflix ‘s upcoming festive family film, Dilwali Diwali, produced by Terribly Tiny Tales (TTT) and premiering on November 5.
 Speaking about his seamless journey across television and digital platforms, and his experience working on this heartwarming project, Ashish Kaul shares his thoughts. “The medium might change, but the core of storytelling remains rooted in connection. Whether it is the daily emotional landscape of television or the nuanced, tightly knit narratives of the web, an actor’s job is to find the truth of the character. Transitioning between TV and digital platforms keeps you on your toes and allows you to explore dimensions of performance that speak to different sets of audiences.”
 Talking about his experience in Netflix’s Dilwali Diwali, he shares, “The moment I heard the story of ‘Dilwali Diwali’, I knew it was something truly special. It isn’t heavy or complicated; it is a simple, lovable, and deeply relatable story that everyone will connect with. Working with a phenomenal team, sharing screen space with brilliant actors like Manoj Pahwa, and collaborating with TTT and Netflix has been an absolute delight. The film has a massive heart, and I am excited for audiences to be a part of this family journey.”
